description: Media destinations and formats — music / videos / images / ebooks / rockbox / pico286 etc. Preserve music subfolders because TreeFrogUI treats each folder under roms/music as playlist.

music.playlist_semantics: Each folder under roms/music is a playlist; preserve hierarchy
music.player: cubegm/video_player (hardware-backed simple player) + rockbox standalone for advanced
music.notes: Copy as-is; do not flatten. Supports ID3 metadata preview where practical.

videos.compatibility: Do not assume .mp4/.mkv compatible merely by extension — inspect via ffprobe
videos.notes: Drop ordinary MP4/MKV/AVI/MOV files; hardware decoder determines actual support.

images.viewer: cubegm/image_viewer (libffplayer native picture decoder + hardware video plane)
images.notes: No conversion required; viewer handles Fit/Fill/rotation.

ebooks.notes: Ebook reader saves per-book progress under hidden .positions/ subdirectory — do not sync that.

rockbox.themes: themes.rockbox.org iPod Video 320x240 themes go to roms/rockbox/.rockbox/
rockbox.notes: Separate from simple music player; keep distinct.

pico286.group_semantics: Each game folder contains floppy .img set; hard-disk games packed to .img with RUN.BAT via make_dos_img.sh

prboom.notes: Supply legally obtained IWAD (doom1.wad, heretic1.wad, hexen.wad...) — do not bundle

quake2.notes: Game data must be in baseq2/ subfolder

wolf3d.notes: Wolf3D needs game data + ecwolf.pk3 — see docs/cores/wolf3d.md
